Package it.polimi.ingsw.server.controller

Class GameSupervisor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.server.controller.GameSupervisor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class GameSupervisor extends Object implements Runnable
This class manages the creation of games and the association of players to games. It also keeps track of the games that are currently running, the players that are currently playing and the players that are currently waiting for a game to start.

    • gameOver

      public void gameOver(String gameId)
      This method ends a game, the game controller should call this method right before it stops its thread. It deletes the record of the game and sets the association of the players to the game to "TERMINATED" so that it can be later removed at next startup
      Parameters:
      gameId - the id of the game
